questions.notes: Table gives respondent counts (n=500), pct of respondents and seat allocation ('חלוקת מנדטים'); below-threshold parties marked 'לא עבר' -> seats 0. Whether pct is weighted is not stated. Party pcts sum to ~100 (no undecided row).

extraction_notes: Document is a bare spreadsheet export titled 'תוצאות סקר 20.8' - no pollster or commissioner named anywhere. Fieldwork 19/8 10:00 to 20/8 13:00. Method note: internet panel + phone completions for sectors under-represented in the panel. Initial sample: 10,000 SMS links + 41 phone calls (10,041 requested); 541 answered but 41 were excluded as not matching/out of sample, so 500 respondents; 93% did not respond. Demographic tables (age, sector, gender, region) confirm n=500.
